accepted_at: Database column on pending_invites, set server-side when an invite is claimed. Read from rows in inbox.js and TeamManagement.jsx; nothing in src/ writes it, and nothing should. A true false positive.
readAsDataURL: Not an app data field -- a method on the browser's built-in FileReader, called in src/ShareButton.jsx to convert a rendered share card into base64 for Capacitor's Filesystem plugin. Nothing 'writes' it because there is nothing to write; it ships with every browser.
